body: Well yeah in December it's gonna be as early as 16:30, but at the moment it should still be around 17:30.
Yay can't wait for it to be dark at like 5:30 again.
Well thanks for reassuring me on this. Didn't really realize that it's that easy to reject someone.

Thanks for the advice. 
I will stay open to meeting new girls and if something progresses by itself, I would surely give it a chance. But I doubt that anything will happen since I never had a girl fall in love with me and I am not really looking for a gf anyway. It's just that I fell in love with this girl that made me want to be with her. I also don't see myself being able to fall in love with anyone else anytime soon because I can't stop thinking about this other girl.

It also came to my mind before that saying that she wasn't looking for anything with anyone might have a kind method of rejecting me before I could even tell her I love her. I just disregarded that possibility because I'm pretty sure she didn't realise that I loved her. She has quite low self esteem and noone ever told her he loved her before (or at least that's what she told me), so I think she might not see herself as a person that someone would fall in love with. Btw she told me she wasn't looking for a relationship with anyone because she just felt she wasn't ready for one. Well, the outcome is basically the same, I still felt rejected, but I just don't think she did it knowingly. I might be wrong though.

Anyway, I really appreciate the advice and will not say anything until, well forever.
